verdict.rationale: WooCommerce ships WC-CLI for command-line store management and a REST API for scripted automation, which supports some headless/CI-style operations, but there is no evidence of a documented headless runtime mode, containerized CI test harness, or official guidance for running WooCommerce end-to-end in a CI pipeline. missing for 10: documented headless/CI deployment pattern, official CI/testing pipeline integration, evidence of automated store provisioning without a GUI.
